text:
ravi: Heads-up — someone in onboarding reported the "vector-store" quickstart embedding sample stopped working after SDK bump.
tess: which sample? paste?
ravi: README currently shows Python snippet that uses `create_embeddings(input=...)` but the SDK 0.9 rename changed the param to `inputs` and the method to `embeddings.create`. Users hit a runtime TypeError.
lee: oh no. we shipped the README before the SDK change landed. can you paste the broken snippet?
ravi: copy from docs: 
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client(os.environ["REDWOOD_KEY"])
vec = client.create_embeddings(model="rwd-embed-1", input="hello")
```
lee: that will break on modern SDKs. correct usage now is: 
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client(os.environ["REDWOOD_KEY"])
vec = client.embeddings.create(model="rwd-embed-1", inputs=["hello"])
```
tess: ugh. Node quickstart also diverges. our Node README still shows `client.embeddings("model").create("text")` (old style) while the current API expects `client.embeddings.create({ model, inputs })`. new users copy the snippet and get "TypeError: embeddings.create is not a function" or confusing runtime errors.
ravi: docs-bot: linter flagged method-name mismatch between docs and SDK metadata.
docs-bot: automated check: found 3 instances of deprecated embedding calls in /quickstarts/vector-store README. Suggested PR template: replace old calls, add compatibility note, and bump examples for both sync and async variants.
lee: let's do a small patch but also add a compatibility section: "If you're using SDK v<0.9, use old-call; v>=0.9 use new-call". People running pinned older SDKs should know why it fails.
tess: also add a short note about parameter name change: "inputs is now a list of strings; single-string usage must be wrapped in [\"...\"]". Lots of users were pasting single-string snippets into our vector-store sample and getting model errors.
sam: can we include both Python sync and async examples and Node callback/promises? parity is important. file an SDK parity issue too so language teams coordinate the examples.
docs-bot: created issue #4988: "quickstart embed API parity + README compatibility note".
lee: i'll open a PR that: (1) replaces deprecated method calls, (2) adds compatibility note, (3) adds Node and Python async examples, (4) runs docs linter.
ci-bot: PR checks: please include example tests (snippets smoke test) or CI will fail.
lee: noted — adding snippet smoke test to the quickstart test harness.
docs-bot: recommended wording for compatibility note drafted in PR body.
lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2507 — includes updated snippets and compatibility section.
tess: add a short changelog entry under "Docs changes" to explain the reason in case customers search the changelog.
lee: good call, will add.
ravi: support confirmed at least two customers hit this yesterday while onboarding. thanks for the fast turnaround.
docs-bot: PR merged to main and deployed to staging docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/quickstarts/vector-store.
sam: follow-up: should we add a quick note in SDK release notes and link to docs compatibility paragraph so people pinned to old SDKs can find guidance?
lee: will add link to release notes in the PR and ping SDK leads.
tess: closing loop once CI snippet tests pass in main. thanks all.
